[center][font=Georgia]﻿
[b][color=#f4cccc][size=5]*[font=Georgia] [/font][/size][font=Georgia][size=2]I won't be working on my mods anymore due to health issues. I'm very sorry. ; _ ;

[img]http://fs5.directupload.net/images/171001/tchdvmmg.png[/img]

[b][font=Georgia][size=4][color=#dbb0a7]＊ About [/color][b][font=Georgia][color=#dbb0a7]＊
[/color][/font][/b][/size][/font][/b]
[font=Georgia]If you're looking for a magical touch-up, then you probably just found the right place~ [color=#ffe599]☆[/color]

This mod lets you craft and place up to [b][color=#dbb0a7]24[/color][/b] different kinds of flowers, herbs, shrooms and crystals on your farm or wherever you like!
They are very odd, colourful and fantasy themed, some of them are even glowing. As the name already says, they're decorative items only (for now).

[b][color=#f4cccc]~ Witchy decorations is a JSON assets mod! Yay! ~[/color][/b]
Thanks to the work of the lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52098691]Geminia[/url]﻿, you can use my decorations as a JA mod from now on!
This also means, that you can craft them [i]immersively[/i] and all of the items even have their own names and lore, isn't that awesome?!
Please also check out the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3374]PPJA project[/url]﻿ she's a part of! They revive old/abandoned mods and convert them into JA versions~ !

[u]Note[/u]: The [color=#9fc5e8]winter version[/color] is currently not used, but the .png file is still in the pack, so if you want to make it a seasonal version on your own, go ahead! [color=#f4cccc]♥[/color][/font]


[b][font=Georgia][color=#dbb0a7][size=4]＊ Installation [b][font=Georgia]＊[/font][/b][/size][/color][/font][/b]
[font=Georgia]
• Make sure you have the [u]latest version[/u] of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿ installed correctly!
• Download and unpack the zip file
• You'll have a folder named [i]"[JA] Witchy Decorations",[/i] just drop it as it is in [i]Stardew Valley\Mods[/i]
• Aaaand you're done! [color=#f4cccc]♥[/color] Hop onto your farm and open your crafting menu to take a look~ !
[/font][font=Georgia]
[/font]
